about_short_description.short_description: Graphite is an open source CLI and a code review dashboard.

product.name: Graphite Code Review Platform
product.description: A cloud-based code review platform for GitHub that combines pull request management, stacked workflows, AI-assisted review, team collaboration, and merge automation.

product.name: Graphite Agent
product.description: An AI-assisted code review service that analyzes pull requests for bugs, logical errors, security and performance issues, and organization-specific coding patterns.

product.name: Graphite CLI
product.description: A command-line Git interface for creating, managing, visualizing, submitting, and synchronizing stacked pull requests.

product.name: Graphite Merge Queue
product.description: A stack-aware merge automation service that merges pull requests in order, maintains a green main branch, and reduces redundant CI execution.

product.name: Graphite Insights
product.description: A developer productivity analytics service that reports historical metrics on pull requests, reviews, and engineering workflow performance.

product.name: Graphite Visual Studio Code Extension
product.description: A Visual Studio Code extension for creating, modifying, submitting, visualizing, and synchronizing stacked pull requests from within the IDE.
